about_the_game:
Bunny Bunker mixes  base building with tower defense as you build your bunny colony. Help your colony get strong enough to launch into space and escape the hordes that attack every night. With around 5 hours of gameplay.

Overview

In the world of Bunny Bunker, you lead a determined colony of bunnies on a mission to build, survive, and reach the stars in their home made rockets. Every day brings new challenges and every night threatening security, you'll need to optimize resources, construct defenses, and guide your worker, builder and warriors bunnies through dangerous waves of darkness and despair (sorry for the tackynes, but these 3 words just sounded cool together).

Key Features

Build, Expand and Survive

Plan and expand your colony to create a functioning econonomy. To keep going, you harvest wood, stone, and carrots to sustain your population and build essential infrastructure. Maintain food supplies and build infrastructure to support defense efforts and unlock rocket technology.

Defend the Colony

Daylight hours are for resource gathering, repairs, and nighttime planning. Night are for intense tower defense battles - where you use the walls, traps and towers that was build during the day, and move your Warrior Bunnies around to protect against monstrous invaders that finds ways around your defences. Unlock and upgrade towers and traps to withstand increasingly difficult night assaults.

Rocket Escape Campaign

With each hostile wave becoming more and more difficult, build toward the escape before things gets to crazy: a rocket launch. Build up everything and prepare your colony for a one-way trip to space before the monsters of the dark destroys the colony.

About the World

The planet where the Bunnies live was once a paradise, its bunkers brimming with laughter and community. But monsters, having plenty to eat, grew strong in their nunmbers and agression. Now, groups of Bunnies build defences and live in close communities to fight of the enemies.

Your role is to these colonies through strategic construction and nighttime combat.

Give hope a chance—and bring your Bunnies to the stars!

name: Bunny Bunker Demo
short_description: Strategy by day, tactical tower defense by night. Build a bunny colony, manage resources, and defend against nightly monster attacks in this mix of city building and tower defence. Help your bunnies escape to the stars before the darkness destroys everything.
